findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are selection/observable descriptors rather than physical interaction energies.

The observed window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available in this packet.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed support show sign changes and strong sign conflicts for landmark local coordinate features (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts), and no polynomial fit is accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, extrapolation_allowed=false) for the rows read.

First-rate and last-rate z values for the same features are large and opposite in sign (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive; landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative and last_rate_z positive), indicating rate changes across the window rather than a constant rule; whole-window z values are small, so the whole-window mean alone does not capture the time-conditioned structure.

Relative node RMSE for the observed-node linear method is non-trivial (roughly 0.29 to 0.78 across the rows read), so the observed-node interpolation is not a high-fidelity fit and the contrast curves should not be treated as absolute reward targets.

hypotheses.falsifier: no accepted fit or no reproducible sign-change structure across independent batches
hypotheses.observable: landmark local coordinate contrast features over the observed score window
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule (using validated observed-node contrast changes across the window) would express the landmark local-coordinate sign changes better than a constant whole-window rule, but only if the observed-node fit fidelity is adequate.

hypotheses.falsifier: joint diagnostics show no coupling beyond marginal evidence
hypotheses.observable: joint landmark local coordinate contrast patterns
hypotheses.statement: Landmark local coordinate contrasts are coupled rather than isolated marginals, so a joint coordinate pattern may carry information that isolated marginal descriptors do not.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst, so no causal selection effect or atom-velocity claim is supported.
Continuous contrast curves are coordinate descriptors, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies.
Only a subset of continuous_trends rows was read; other tables (survival, increment, turnover, joint, regional, branch-adjusted) were not inspected in this turn.
